<thought>Based on the provided subnet data and the measurement table, the network consists of a series chain A‑X1‑X2‑X3‑B with side branches at X1, X2, and X3. Subnet 1 supplies two series resistors between A and X1 (2.222 Ω and 4.445 Ω). Subnet 2 supplies three series resistors between X1 and X2 (5 Ω, 4.444 Ω, 8.889 Ω). Subnet 3 supplies four series resistors between X2 and X3 (5 Ω, 10 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω). Subnet 4 supplies a single resistor of 50 Ω between X3 and B (the value 45 Ω given for subnet 4 appears to be a typo; the measurements require 50 Ω). All resistor names are made unique by prefixing them with the subnet identifier. An auxiliary node “A_X1_mid” is introduced to represent the internal connection of the two resistors in subnet 1. The final topology JSON therefore lists all 10 resistors and their connections.</thought>
